## Summary
Provides shared utility helpers for context values, logging component labels, math and slice helpers, protocol cloning, change notifications, incremental dispatch, ICE config caching, and asynchronous operation queues. The package owns reusable support code used across the server without depending on other packages in this repository.

## Responsibilities
- Store and retrieve request-scoped attempt and logger values from contexts.
- Provide generic math, slice, and protocol-copy helpers.
- Manage observers, incremental item dispatch, TTL-based ICE config caching, and asynchronous operation queues.
- Define logging component constants shared by other packages.
